Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Parts left menu opens for user B, with Returns in it.

Step 2:

  • The Returns list opens for user B, and it has no Create Return button: without Create & Edit a return cannot be started on screen.

Step 3:

  • The address is typed.

Step 4:

  • The Create Return page opens for user B, because its address was typed directly (as in today's app).

Step 5:

  • Vendor A is shown.

Step 6:

  • The part search shows the app's standard access error instead of results, and part A is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S9-N3: “Picking parts on a vendor return or a vendor credit needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → View' permission, or another setting that carries part search access today, as it does today. Without it the part search there shows the standard access error.”
  • S9-N3a: “Opening Parts → Returns and starting a vendor return keep the access today's 'Vendor Order Management' settings give. This feature adds, removes and changes no permission (S12-N1). 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit' carries part search access, so a role with it can search for parts on a return even though its 'Part Library & Inventory → View' box is not ticked. No on-screen route reaches S9-N3, because every role that can start a return has part search access; the access error shows only when the Create Return page is opened by its address, by a role with 'Vendor Order Management → View' and no setting that carries part search access.”
  • S12-N1: “No permission is added, removed or re-keyed. Every user's access on release day is identical to the day before.”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 22: “(b) Not on screen: without Create & Edit, the Create Return button doesn't show. Today the Create Return page still opens if its address is typed directly. That's a gap in production now, which this feature doesn't change.”
  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 22: “(c) Not through normal screens. Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit, which is what shows Create Return, also gives part search access, so every role that can start a return can search parts. To see the S9-N3 error, use a role with Vendor Order Management → View only and none of the other settings that give part search access (Part Library & Inventory → View, Part Sales → Create & Edit, work order pick parts, Settings Parts, See financial data). Then type the Create Return address directly and search for a part.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
